name: Buffer
summary: Social media scheduling and analytics tool with a free plan and AI assistance.
description: Buffer plans, schedules and publishes posts across social networks, with an idea library, analytics, community engagement, team collaboration and a link-in-bio page. The Free plan connects up to three channels. Essentials costs $5 per month per channel, with a 14-day free trial. Paid plans also cover team collaboration and approval workflows. Pricing is per connected channel, so costs scale with the number of social accounts managed.

howToUse.title: Open Buffer
howToUse.description: Go to Buffer and get started for free. On the Free plan you can connect three channels.

howToUse.title: Schedule posts from an idea library
howToUse.description: Build an idea library, then schedule and publish posts across the social networks you connect.

howToUse.title: Review analytics and collaborate
howToUse.description: Use analytics and community engagement, and build the Start Page as a link-in-bio. Paid plans cover team collaboration and approval workflows. Essentials costs $5 per month per channel and comes with a 14-day trial. Pricing follows each connected channel, so the number of accounts managed changes the cost.

features_fr: Outil de planification et d'analyse des réseaux sociaux avec un plan gratuit et une assistance par l'IA.

Buffer planifie, programme et publie des publications sur les réseaux sociaux, avec une bibliothèque d'idées, des analyses, un engagement communautaire, une collaboration d'équipe et une page de liens dans la bio.
Le forfait Free connecte jusqu’à trois chaînes.
Essentials coûte 5 $ par mois et par chaîne, avec un essai gratuit de 14 jours.
